title: 即戦力
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: LEFT ①: quiet Tsumugi (DARK BROWN bob/PURPLE HOODIE) shows her tablet drawing of a LEAF-EARED CAT with smoky curl tail, BLACK CAP and tiny BLACK HOODIE resembling Hajime. She says 「はじめさん描いた。」 Real adult Hajime leans over impressed. RIGHT ②: that exact CARTOON CAT drawing has stepped OFF the tablet into the cafe and is now efficiently serving THREE trays of tea and cash-register service simultaneously with an absurd array of little paper-illustration arms, tail tidying a menu. The real Hajime and Tsumugi watch, not transformed. Cat cheerfully says 「いらっしゃい。」 Hajime looks at his own empty hands and says 「俺より働く。」 Tablet shows a clear cat-shaped empty white space. No actual magic added to canon, this is the surreal spin-off cartoon.
